use py:statistics as stats
use go:strings as gstr
use go:math as gmath
use rs:std.str as rstr
use rs:std.i64 as ri

unit ms
unit s = 1000 ms

record RawSample {
    service: Text
    ms: Int
    offset: Int
}

record Request {
    sla_s: Float
    samples: List[RawSample]
}

record Sample {
    service: Text
    ms: Int
    offset: Int
    bucket: Int
    valid_label: Bool
}

fn normalize_service(name: Text) -> Text = gstr.ToLower(rstr.trim(name))

fn is_valid_label(name: Text) -> Bool =
    let n = rstr.len_chars(name) in
    n >= 2 and n <= 12

fn prepare_sample(raw: RawSample) -> Sample =
    let service = normalize_service(raw.service) in
    Sample(
        service: service,
        ms: raw.ms,
        offset: raw.offset,
        bucket: ri.rem_euclid(raw.offset, 4),
        valid_label: is_valid_label(service)
    )

fn is_raw_breach(sample: Sample, sla_ms: Float) -> Bool pure =
    to_float(sample.ms) > sla_ms

fn is_exempt_window(sample: Sample) -> Bool pure =
    sample.service == "healthcheck" and sample.bucket == 0

fn is_breach(sample: Sample, sla_ms: Float) -> Bool pure =
    is_raw_breach(sample, sla_ms) and is_exempt_window(sample) == false

fn round_banker(x: Float) -> Int = to_int(gmath.RoundToEven(x))

fn severity(ms: Int) -> Text pure = cases ms {
    < 200 => "ok"
    <= 500 => "warn"
    <= 1000 => "slow"
    else => "critical"
}

fn overall_status(consecutive_breaches: Int, critical: Int, breaches: Int, invalid_labels: Int) -> Text pure =
    if consecutive_breaches >= 2 or critical > 0 then "red"
    else if breaches > 0 or invalid_labels > 0 then "yellow"
    else "green"

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let sla_ms_q: Float[ms] = (req.sla_s as s) to ms
let sla_ms: Float = scalar(sla_ms_q)
let sla_ms_int: Int = round_banker(sla_ms)
let samples = [prepare_sample(r) for r in req.samples]

let summary = summarize x in samples {
    total: count
    breaches: count where is_breach(x, sla_ms)
    overage_ms: sum (x.ms - sla_ms_int) where is_breach(x, sla_ms)
    max_ms: max x.ms default 0
    bucket_zero: count where x.bucket == 0
    critical: count where severity(x.ms) == "critical"
    warn_or_worse: count where severity(x.ms) != "ok"
    invalid_labels: count where x.valid_label == false
    exempt: count where is_raw_breach(x, sla_ms) and is_exempt_window(x)
}

let valid_ms = [to_float(x.ms) for x in samples where x.valid_label]
let mean_ms: Int =
    if len(valid_ms) == 0 then 0
    else round_banker(stats.mean(valid_ms))

let audited = [record { ms: x.ms, breached: is_breach(x, sla_ms) } for x in samples]
let consecutive_breaches: Int = count adjacent past, now in audited where past.breached and now.breached
let spike_steps: Int = count adjacent past, now in audited where now.ms > past.ms + 100
let regressed: Int = count earlier past, now in audited where past.ms + 300 < now.ms
let status: Text = overall_status(consecutive_breaches, summary.critical, summary.breaches, summary.invalid_labels)

let out = record {
    count: summary.total,
    breaches: summary.breaches,
    overage_ms: summary.overage_ms,
    max_ms: summary.max_ms,
    mean_ms,
    bucket_zero: summary.bucket_zero,
    critical: summary.critical,
    warn_or_worse: summary.warn_or_worse,
    consecutive_breaches,
    spike_steps,
    invalid_labels: summary.invalid_labels,
    exempt: summary.exempt,
    regressed,
    status
}

print json_encode(out)
